english.title: Interested person give false information re premises in designated high street or town centre
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who appeared to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) to have an interest in land in which premises

(A)_[on a designated high street]_
(B)_[within a designated town centre]_

were comprised, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), gave information about those premises to that local authority in response to a requirement under section 210(2) of the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023 which was false namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE INFORMATION..) and which you knew, or reasonably should have known, was false
english.legislation: Contrary to section 210(7)(b) and (8) of the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being an interested person
gave information which was false
and which you knew, or reasonably should have known, was false
in response to a requirement under section 210(2)
